description: Check any order (top-up, gift card or eSIM; see kind): waiting for payment, confirming, sending, delivered, expired, or needs attention. While waiting it repeats pay_url. Once a gift card is delivered the result holds giftcard.cards (code and PIN); once an eSIM is delivered it holds esim (QR code link, one-tap install links, LPA string). These are SECRETS for the buyer only: give them only to the person who paid, never post, share or store them anywhere else. A delivered eSIM also has usage (status not_started, active, ended or unknown; data_left_gb of data_total_gb or unlimited; ends_at; days_left), or null when it cannot be read right now.
name: get_order
title: Order status
